logical_io.traffic_definition: sum of certified boundary input and output payload bytes; not measured DRAM transactions

caveats: one add/sub/mul/div counts as one FLOP; FMA would count as two
transcendentals are reported separately and are not assigned an arbitrary FLOP weight
comparisons are reported separately from FLOPs

performance.timing: pinned-process perf_counter_ns via ctypes C ABI

upstream_evidence: FP32 and shape (4096,4096) are exercised by the upstream-facing PK harness
